description: One row per creator: the full feature table plus the presentation fields the product shows (name, city, platforms, rate card).
The six showcase campaigns, their budgets, briefs and eligibility policy.
Creator Quality: the brand-independent score, its seven components, its band and the reason string shown in the product.
Organisation Fit: the long-term brand-creator relationship score and its six components, including visual similarity and the three-part brand safety term.
Campaign Fit: per campaign and creator, the six components, the hard-gate outcome, the block reason where one fired, and the reason string.
Predicted audience authenticity band and score per creator, with the true inauthentic share the model was scored against.
Per-creator comment-section profile: sentiment shares, toxicity rate, automation rate, duplication, length. Labels come from classifiers trained on TweetEval, a real human-annotated corpus.
24,000 individual comments with their model labels and surface features. SIMULATED text (src/creator_data/comments.py); REAL classifiers.
Which creators have connected their Instagram account, when, and under which scopes. Connection is SIMULATED.
Owner-only metrics for connected creators: saves, shares, watch time, dwell, profile visits, follows-from-post, and the full audience age, gender, geography and language split. SIMULATED.
20,000 posts with their owner-only metrics. SIMULATED.
Feed coherence and six readable visual attributes per creator. The encoder is SIMULATED; no image exists.
Which formats a creator offers, how each performs against their own baseline, their booked window and the notice they need.
The SIMULATED behavioural log: 10,699 brand-creator events across 120 brands, used to train the learned ranker and the collaborative filter.
Each brand's idiosyncratic taste weights. Never exposed as a model feature - this is what the collaborative filter has to recover.
The percentile attribute matrix both the composite and the brands score against.
Top 60 collaborative-filtering scores per brand.
Out-of-fold scores from the hand-set composite, the learned linear weights and the LambdaRank model, for every logged event.

SIMULATED voice track for every video post: valence, arousal, speech rate, pause and music ratio, the audio sentiment label, and whether it disagrees with the caption model. No audio exists (src/nlp/audio_sim.py).
SIMULATED per-creator voice profile aggregated from audio_posts. Two of its columns feed the content-safety component of the fit composite.
The lexical profile behind the typed-brief matcher: the forty heaviest TF-IDF terms for each creator, L2-normalised.
Every term the typed-brief matcher can recognise, with its document frequency and inverse document frequency.
Which creator mentioned which brand, how often, and whether any of it was a disclosed paid post - the evidence the competitor-conflict veto reads.
Every (campaign, creator) pair with its fit composite, components, safety gates and ranking under each objective.
The request funnel: who was approached for which campaign, at what fee, and how far they got.
Negotiation threads attached to requests.
Cumulative count of requests reaching each funnel stage, per campaign.
Campaign-level results including predicted-vs-actual calibration.
Per-creator delivered reach, engagement, cost, CPE and CPR.
Past brand approaches per creator, outside the six showcase campaigns.
Monthly realised earnings per creator.
Each creator's brand-fit score against a representative brand in every category.
Out-of-fold predicted vs actual campaign engagement rate, by brand category.
The synthetic brand universe: category, budget, target audience, competitors.
The pipeline's SBERT-scored brand-fit matrix (top 60 creators per brand).
A sample of posts with captions and their per-post NLP labels.
The table the performance model is trained on: one row per campaign, with the creator's features and the realised campaign outcome.
The full engineered feature table, before the product layer is applied.
Accuracy and macro-F1 for every NLP method on every human-labelled corpus.
LightGBM split gain per feature.
Mean absolute SHAP contribution per feature.
The strongest co-behaviour edges between creators.
BERTopic topics with their top words.
